g.text: Sequence Diagram - UC-10 - Configure Timer Profiles
create, edit, delete profile or select default
add, update, select or remove profile
- profile name is trimmed, non-empty and case-insensitively unique
- at least one profile remains; select a new default before deleting
- new profiles copy the current default profile
Timer profiles include independent work and break auto-start flags.
